questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Mathematics Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Solve for x:
x² − 4x − 5 = 0
questions.explanation: NSC 2022 Mathematics P1 memo: factorise (x − 5)(x + 1) = 0 → x = 5 or x = −1.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Mathematics Paper 1 · Question 1.2

Solve for x:
2x² = 4x
questions.explanation: NSC 2022 Mathematics P1 memo: 2x(x − 2) = 0 → x = 0 or x = 2.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Mathematics Paper 1 · Question 1.3

Solve for x (correct to TWO decimal places):
x² − 3x − 1 = 0
questions.explanation: NSC 2022 Mathematics P1 memo: quadratic formula gives x ≈ 3.30 or x ≈ −0.30 (2 d.p.).
